beaches.name: Paradise Beach (Telendos)
beaches.summary: The small cove north of Telendos village operates as a nudist beach with sunbeds. A naturist directory carries reports from 2000 to 2021 and describes a 'Paradise beach nudist beach' sign and a family running the sunbeds; TripAdvisor lists it as Paradise Nudist Beach. In 2021 sunbeds cost 5 euros.
